name: Pennsylvania
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Pennsylvania's land extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward). The north edge is the tip of the Erie triangle on the Lake Erie shore (42.27); the state's share of the lake itself, which runs to ~42.5, is trimmed because every extra degree of water is paid for in tiles. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-pa.
